physical_state_in: Bagged beans or containerised semi-finished products at sea
physical_state_out: Same commodity cleared through EU customs at Rotterdam/Amsterdam
primary_transformation: EU customs clearance with EUDR deforestation-free due diligence documentation
measurable_output: Tonnes cleared through EU customs with valid EUDR due diligence statement
D_parameters: EUDR documentation burden (100% polygon coverage required by 2025-12-30); phytosanitary inspection risk; vessel scheduling volatility; freight rate volatility
C_parameters: World-class Rotterdam/Amsterdam port infrastructure; Dutch customs digital clearance system (AGS); established ECA certificate of origin workflow; NVWA pre-notification system
notes: Port of Rotterdam Authority publishes annual commodity throughput statistics. NVWA inspection data available. EUDR compliance creates formal documentation trail for all EU cocoa imports.

physical_state_in: Cleared cocoa beans or semi-finished in bonded warehouse
physical_state_out: ECA-graded warehouse-receipted cocoa ready for processing or trade
primary_transformation: ECA 300-bean cut test grading + cadmium/lead NVWA sampling + futures market warehousing
measurable_output: ECA-graded warehouse receipts by grade and weight
D_parameters: Multiple warehouse operators (basis risk); ECA grading complexity; LIFFE futures market timing pressure; cadmium/lead test results can block release
C_parameters: ECA standardised grading certificates; Amsterdam commodity exchange warehouse receipts; LIFFE/ICE Futures Europe cocoa market; electronic warehouse management systems
notes: ECA publishes grading standards. NVWA publishes enforcement actions. LIFFE provides market data. Warehouse operators publish capacity data.

physical_state_in: ECA-graded cocoa beans from bonded warehouse
physical_state_out: Cocoa liquor + cocoa butter + cocoa powder (semi-finished products)
primary_transformation: Roasting + cracking + winnowing + grinding to liquor + hydraulic pressing to butter/powder
measurable_output: Tonnes of semi-finished cocoa products by type (liquor/butter/powder)
D_parameters: Cadmium regulatory limits requiring origin blending (EU 1881/2006); energy price volatility; oligopoly concentration (3 firms >60%); EUDR traceability obligation on input beans
C_parameters: World-class Amsterdam grinding infrastructure; EU food safety compliance; company traceability systems (BC Cocoa Horizons / Cargill Cocoa Promise); renewable energy adoption programs
notes: ICCO publishes grinding data by country. Major processors publish Netherlands volumes in annual reports. EU food safety enforcement records available via NVWA.

physical_state_in: Cocoa butter (from Phase 2 95%) + shea butter (imported from West Africa 5% weight)
physical_state_out: CBEs (Cocoa Butter Equivalents): shea stearin blended with other permitted vegetable fats; ready for chocolate manufacturing
primary_transformation: Shea butter dry fractionation to extract stearin fraction + blending with cocoa butter and other CBE fats (illipe/sal/palm mid-fraction)
measurable_output: Tonnes of CBE products by type
D_parameters: Single-site concentration risk (IOI Loders Croklaan Wormerveer dominant European CBE producer); shea supply chain opacity from West Africa (Phase 4 Export D=210 C=165 balance=64.0%); EU food additive approval requirements for CBEs
C_parameters: IOI Loders Croklaan 80+ years specialty fats expertise; EU food safety regulatory framework; RSPO certification pathway for vegetable fat sustainability; Dutch chemical processing infrastructure
notes: IOI Loders Croklaan publishes product data. EU Chocolate Directive defines 5% CBE limit. Shea input values from TrueValue shea project Phase 4 Export. Phase 3 composite D=265 C=244 uses 95/5 weighted blend formula.

physical_state_in: Cocoa liquor + cocoa butter/CBE blend + sugar + milk powder
physical_state_out: Finished chocolate bars, confectionery, cocoa powder products, chocolate coatings
primary_transformation: Chocolate tempering and conching + CBE blending + branding + packaging
typical_time_scale: Days to weeks per production run
D_parameters: Retail buyer power (AH/Jumbo/Lidl >75% combined NL grocery share); Tony's Chocolonely pricing pressure creating premium-tier benchmarking; CBE sourcing complexity (managing 5% substitution limit); PPWR packaging requirements
C_parameters: Dutch food innovation culture; consumer sustainability demand (NL #1 EU for certified product purchase intent); Tony's Chocolonely transparency benchmark; EU labeling frameworks
notes: Tony's publishes full supply chain transparency (Annual FAIR Report). Verkade/Mondelez and conventional manufacturers have less granular public data. Retail market shares from Kantar.

physical_state_in: Packaged chocolate products or bulk semi-finished in warehouse
physical_state_out: Products sold in Dutch retail OR bulk semi-finished re-exported to Germany/Belgium/Switzerland/UK as inputs to further manufacturing
primary_transformation: Dutch domestic retail sale (branded + private label) OR B2B re-export of semi-finished cocoa products
measurable_output: Retail sales value (EUR) and re-export volume (metric tonnes)
D_parameters: Albert Heijn/Jumbo/Lidl retail oligopoly price compression; Brexit customs friction on UK re-export channel; German buyer price discipline; sustainability label proliferation creating consumer confusion
C_parameters: Dutch retail logistics efficiency; EU single market access for re-export; established Port of Rotterdam re-export infrastructure; Dutch consumer sustainability literacy (Fairtrade #1 EU)
notes: CBS Netherlands Statistics publishes trade data. Albert Heijn/Jumbo market shares from Kantar. UK export friction from UK government trade statistics.
